name: Outline Crumble
description: Thin cracks run through the first clip along its own outlines, then the pieces they cut sag loose and fall away one after another from the top, tumbling and shrinking into the second clip beneath. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: cells
params.description: Pieces across the height of the frame

params.name: follow
params.description: How closely the cracks follow the outlines of the picture
